learning_outcomes.text: To relay basic knowledge to students at the area of aircraft equilibrium, static and dynamic stability and control, both longitudinal and lateral, basics of aircraft simulations on stability, control and response.
To introduce students to theoretical and practical knowledge in the scope of: aircraft equilibrium, static stability a control – longitudinal and lateral.
To introduce students to theoretical and practical knowledge in the scope of: description of 3D aircraft motion – general equations of motions.
To introduce students to theoretical and practical knowledge in the scope of: determination of aerodynamic forces and moments.
To introduce students to theoretical and practical knowledge in the scope of: longitudinal dynamic stability – basic longitudinal motions.
To introduce students to theoretical and practical knowledge in the scope of: lateral dynamic stability – basic lateral motions.
To introduce students to theoretical and practical knowledge in the scope of: basics of modeling and simulation of aircraft maneuvers.
To introduce students to theoretical and practical knowledge in the scope of: basics of automatic stability and control.

syllabus_topics: aircraft equilibrium, static stability a control – longitudinal and lateral
description of 3D aircraft motion – general equations of motions
determination of aerodynamic forces and moments
longitudinal dynamic stability – basic longitudinal motions
lateral dynamic stability – basic lateral motions
basics of modeling and simulation of aircraft maneuvers
basics of automatic stability and control
